label: feasible-box-contact-v1
policy: Four previously tested development box episodes, twelve frozen control choices each. One explicit alternative global contact compliance, local 0.7 rad/s reference cap, original object material/geometry and complete source interval. Passive source contact failures remain in the denominator. No held-out episode is used for selection. Integral compensation trials include an explicit 30 mrad servo-command bound; actual margin remains independently gated.
